title: What determines banks' excess demand for reserves?
title_zh: 什么决定了银行的超额准备金需求？
title_primary: 什么决定了银行的超额准备金需求？
title_secondary: What determines banks' excess demand for reserves?
authors: Per Asberg-Sommar, Mathias Drehmann, Denise Hansson, Vatsala Shreeti
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What determines banks’ demand for holding reserves at the central bank overnight? This has become a critical question for central banks that are shrinking their balance sheets. We exploit the unique operational framework in Sweden and quantify the factors that drive banks’ demand to hold excess reserves at the central bank. Using granular data, we document significant fragmentation in interbank markets with a set of banks that never trade in interbank markets (inactive banks) and others that do (active banks). Active banks’ excess reserves increase with their payment flow volatility and the cost of borrowing in interbank markets. Furthermore, excess reserve holdings shrink when aggregate interbank activity is high. Inactive banks’ excess reserves also increase with their payment flow volatility but show greater persistence over time, underlining their passivity. Our findings not only shed light on the bank-level drivers of excess reserve demand but also on likely dynamics in untested demand-driven floors.
abstract_zh: 什么因素决定了银行在央行隔夜持有准备金的需求？对于正在缩减资产负债表的中央银行而言，这已成为一个关键问题。我们利用瑞典独特的操作框架，量化了驱动银行在央行持有超额准备金需求的因素。基于细粒度数据，我们记录了银行间市场的显著分割现象，其中一部分银行从不参与银行间市场交易（非活跃银行），而其他银行则参与交易（活跃银行）。活跃银行的超额准备金随其支付流波动性和银行间市场借贷成本上升而增加。此外，当银行间市场总体活动水平较高时，超额准备金持有量会减少。非活跃银行的超额准备金也随其支付流波动性增加而上升，但其持有量在时间上表现出更强的持续性，凸显了其被动性。我们的发现不仅揭示了超额准备金需求的银行层面驱动因素，还为未经检验的需求驱动型利率下限的可能动态提供了见解。

title: Trade agreements, trade facilitation and mutual recognition arrangements
title_zh: 贸易协定、贸易便利化与互认安排
title_primary: 贸易协定、贸易便利化与互认安排
title_secondary: Trade agreements, trade facilitation and mutual recognition arrangements
authors: Bernard Hoekman, Anirudh Shingal
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Governments use preferential trade agreements (PTAs), the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) and mutual recognition arrangements (MRAs) to reduce bilateral trade costs. Using data for 2010-2022 and a structural gravity framework, we assess the trade impact of a country-pair using all three policy instruments simultaneously. Our analysis considers MRAs for Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs that expedite customs clearance for certified actors in the supply chain. These are not product-specific, permitting comparative analysis of the trade impacts of the three types of international agreements. We find significant sectoral heterogeneity across the three instruments. The TFA has large effects on bilateral trade in non-food manufacturing products, while MRAs do more to boost the value of trade in agricultural and food-related products. Overall, international cooperation to reduce the costs of regulatory heterogeneity increases bilateral trade more than PTAs.
abstract_zh: 各国政府通过优惠贸易协定（PTAs）、世界贸易组织《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）以及相互承认安排（MRAs）来降低双边贸易成本。利用2010年至2022年的数据及结构性引力模型框架，我们评估了一对国家同时采用这三种政策工具对贸易的影响。我们的分析聚焦于授权经济经营者（AEO）项目的MRAs，这些项目旨在加速供应链中经认证参与者的海关清关流程。这些措施并非针对特定产品，从而允许对三类国际协定的贸易影响进行比较分析。我们发现，这三种工具在不同行业间存在显著的异质性。TFA对非食品制造业产品的双边贸易影响显著，而MRAs则更有利于提升农产品及食品相关产品的贸易额。总体而言，旨在减少监管差异成本的国际合作对双边贸易的促进作用超过了PTAs。

title: The Impact of Financial Support to Firms During Crises: The Case of Covid Aid in the EU
title_zh: 危机期间企业金融支持的影响：欧盟新冠援助案例
title_primary: 危机期间企业金融支持的影响：欧盟新冠援助案例
title_secondary: The Impact of Financial Support to Firms During Crises: The Case of Covid Aid in the EU
authors: Giulia Canzian, Elena Crivellaro, Tomaso Duso, Antonella Rita Ferrara, Alessandro Sasso 等
official: 官方在线 2025-04-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the effectiveness of Covid-related financial support in Spain and Italy, focusing on its impact on firm recovery. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach combined with propensity score weighting, it compares outcomes of similar firms receiving aid to those without. The results show significant benefits for micro-firms, including mitigated turnover declines and increased investments in both tangible and intangible assets. The findings highlight the critical role of government support in business survival and recovery, especially for SMEs, during the pandemic.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了西班牙与意大利新冠疫情相关金融支持政策的有效性，重点关注其对企业复苏的影响。采用双重差分法结合倾向得分加权，比较了获得援助的相似企业与未获援助企业的结果差异。研究结果表明，微型企业获益显著，具体表现为营业额降幅收窄，且对有形资产与无形资产的投入均有所增加。这些发现凸显了疫情期间政府支持对企业生存与复苏的关键作用，尤其对中小企业而言。

title: Not in my backyard: Personal bias in mutual fund voting on environmental and social proposals
title_zh: 不要在我家后院：共同基金对环境与社会提案投票中的个人偏见
title_primary: 不要在我家后院：共同基金对环境与社会提案投票中的个人偏见
title_secondary: Not in my backyard: Personal bias in mutual fund voting on environmental and social proposals
authors: Ryan Flugum, Choonsik Lee, Matthew E. Souther
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Fund managers cast votes that are more critical of firm environmental and social (ES) practices when the firm has operations located close to fund headquarters. This elevated support for shareholder ES proposals is not mirrored in governance proposals, which likely have less impact on the local community. We find similar pro-ES fund voting practices at firms with operations near the fund manager’s college and prior employment locations and in utility companies that provide electric and gas service to the fund’s address. Manager and sub-advisor turnover events provide additional evidence: tracking the same decision-maker’s votes at a fixed set of firms before and after the move, we find that support for ES proposals increases significantly once the manager gains proximity to those firms. The proximity effect is concentrated at high-polluting plants, consistent with managers responding to personal exposure to environmental harm. We conclude that fund managers exhibit a personal bias in ES voting, being more likely to support ES proposals that impact them personally.
abstract_zh: 当企业运营地点邻近基金总部时，基金经理投出的票更倾向于对企业环境与社会（ES）实践持批评态度。这种对股东ES提案支持度的提升并未在治理提案中体现，后者对当地社区的影响可能较小。我们发现，在企业运营地点靠近基金经理的大学及先前工作地点，以及向基金地址提供电力和燃气服务的公用事业公司中，也存在类似的亲ES基金投票行为。经理及副顾问更替事件提供了额外证据：追踪同一决策者在固定企业集合中迁移前后的投票情况，我们发现一旦经理获得与这些企业的邻近性，对ES提案的支持度显著增加。邻近效应集中在高污染工厂，这与经理因个人接触环境损害而作出反应相符。我们得出结论，基金经理在ES投票中表现出个人偏见，更倾向于支持那些对其个人有影响的ES提案。

title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
title_zh: 不可观测选项下的随机效用
title_primary: 不可观测选项下的随机效用
title_secondary: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
authors: Kono, Haruki, Saito, Kota, Sandroni, Alec
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them.
abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）作为经济学的重要基石，通常在假设所有备选方案的选择频率均可观测的条件下进行研究。然而在实践中，部分备选方案的选择频率无法观测，通常被合并为单一类别，即外部选项。我们在此类环境下研究RUM，推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限且无冗余的不等式约束系统，该系统刻画了RU可理性化的特征。研究表明，将不可观测备选方案进行合并的传统做法可能遗漏关键信息，导致即使不存在任何RUM与观测数据一致时，仍会得出观测选择具有可理性化的错误结论。

title: Interbank Rate Uncertainty and Bank Lending
title_zh: 银行间利率不确定性与银行贷款
title_primary: 银行间利率不确定性与银行贷款
title_secondary: Interbank Rate Uncertainty and Bank Lending
authors: Altavilla, Carlo, Carboni, Giacomo, Lenza, Michele, Uhlig, Harald
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose a new measure of interbank rate uncertainty, defined as the crosssectional dispersion in interbank market rates for overnight unsecured loans. We show that higher interbank rate uncertainty increases lending rates for firm loans, with larger impacts during financial stress episodes, like the global financial crisis and the European debt crisis. These effects are mitigated for banks with lower credit risk, stronger capital buffers, and greater access to central bank funding. We interpret these findings through a model of bank networks, where interbank rate uncertainty rises with the proportion of thinly connected networks, driving up lending rates to firms.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的银行间利率不确定性度量指标，定义为隔夜无担保贷款银行间市场利率的横截面离散度。研究表明，银行间利率不确定性上升会提高企业贷款利率，且在金融压力时期（如全球金融危机和欧洲债务危机）影响更为显著。对于信用风险较低、资本缓冲更强以及获得央行融资渠道更广的银行，这些影响有所缓解。我们通过银行网络模型解释这些发现：当连接稀疏的网络比例上升时，银行间利率不确定性随之增加，进而推高企业贷款利率。

title: The Geography of Financial Frictions
title_zh: 金融摩擦的地理分布
title_primary: 金融摩擦的地理分布
title_secondary: The Geography of Financial Frictions
authors: Alexander Haas, Rustam Jamilov
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the aggregate implications of the geography of financial frictions faced by firms in Europe. Using proprietary data from the European Central Bank's Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises, we document three new facts. First, there is substantial regional heterogeneity in the access to external finance. Second, this heterogeneity is persistent, with only gradual convergence over time. Third, countries with tighter financial frictions are less responsive to monetary shocks. To formalize these empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a tractable New~Keynesian model of a monetary union with 22 countries that are heterogeneous in financial frictions, productivity, and size. High-friction countries are less responsive to monetary shocks because firms face a steeper marginal cost curve and a lower capital elasticity. The heterogeneity in financial frictions also shapes the output-inflation trade-off, as in high-friction countries the same output gain comes at the cost of more inflation. Convergence experiments show that financial market integration in the spirit of a European Savings and Investments Union raises the power of monetary policy, but at a potential cost to financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲企业面临的金融摩擦地理分布对宏观经济的影响。利用欧洲央行《企业融资渠道调查》的专有数据，我们揭示了三个新事实：第一，外部融资渠道存在显著的区域异质性；第二，这种异质性具有持续性，仅随时间呈现渐进式收敛；第三，金融摩擦更严重的国家对货币冲击的反应更弱。为将这些实证发现形式化，我们构建并校准了一个包含22个国家、在金融摩擦、生产率和规模方面存在异质性的可处理新凯恩斯货币联盟模型。高摩擦国家因企业面临更陡峭的边际成本曲线和更低的资本弹性，对货币冲击的反应更弱。金融摩擦的异质性还塑造了产出-通胀权衡关系——在高摩擦国家，同等产出增长需以更高通胀为代价。收敛实验表明，以欧洲储蓄与投资联盟为蓝本的金融市场一体化将增强货币政策效力，但可能以金融稳定为潜在代价。

title: Ranked choice voting with different elimination procedures
title_zh: 不同淘汰程序下的排序选择投票
title_primary: 不同淘汰程序下的排序选择投票
title_secondary: Ranked choice voting with different elimination procedures
authors: Spencer Katzman, Keith L. Dougherty
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Ranked choice voting (RCV) is one of the fastest-growing electoral reforms in the United States, yet few scholars have considered the degree to which RCV could be improved with a different elimination procedure. This paper examines RCV with three different elimination procedures: plurality elimination, negative plurality elimination, and Borda elimination. After some analytical observations, we examine how often RCV with each of these procedures violates three criteria separately: the Condorcet winner criterion, independence of eliminated alternatives, and monotonicity using data from RCV elections in the United States as well as simulated data from the Impartial Culture condition with some trailing rankings removed. Our results show that while there are few differences in US election data, Borda elimination consistently outperforms the traditional plurality elimination by a statistically significant amount in our simulations. Nevertheless, the magnitude of those difference are often small.
abstract_zh: 排序选择制（RCV）是美国发展最快的选举改革之一，但鲜有学者探讨采用不同淘汰程序能否改进RCV。本文研究了三种淘汰程序下的RCV：简单多数淘汰、负向多数淘汰和波达淘汰。在理论分析基础上，我们利用美国RCV选举数据以及移除部分末位排名的无偏文化条件模拟数据，检验了每种程序下RCV违反三项标准（孔多塞赢家标准、淘汰选项独立性、单调性）的频率。结果表明，尽管在美国选举数据中差异甚微，但模拟中波达淘汰在统计上显著优于传统简单多数淘汰。不过，这些差异的幅度通常较小。

title: Estimating individual responses when tomorrow matters
title_zh: 当明天至关重要时：个体反应的估计
title_primary: 当明天至关重要时：个体反应的估计
title_secondary: Estimating individual responses when tomorrow matters
authors: Stéphane Bonhomme, Angela Denis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose an approach to estimate how individuals’ expectations influence their responses to a counterfactual change. The approach relies on average partial effects, which recover counterfactual impacts under conditions that we specify. We propose a three-step estimation method that relies on panel data on subjective expectations. We illustrate our approach in a model of consumption and saving, focusing on the impact of an income tax that not only changes current income but also affects beliefs about future income. Applying our approach to Italian survey data, we find that individuals’ beliefs matter for evaluating the impact of tax policies on consumption decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法来估计个体的预期如何影响其对反事实变化的反应。该方法依赖于平均部分效应，在我们指定的条件下，这些效应能够恢复反事实影响。我们提出一种三步估计方法，该方法依赖于主观预期的面板数据。我们在一个消费与储蓄模型中展示我们的方法，重点关注所得税的影响，该税种不仅改变当前收入，还影响对未来收入的信念。将我们的方法应用于意大利调查数据，我们发现个体的信念对于评估税收政策对消费决策的影响至关重要。

title: Does Automation Lower the Labor Share?
title_zh: 自动化会降低劳动份额吗？
title_primary: 自动化会降低劳动份额吗？
title_secondary: Does Automation Lower the Labor Share?
authors: Zsofia Barany, Asseem Patel, Christian Siegel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A prominent explanation for declining labor shares is automation. We test this mechanism directly at the firm level, drawing on a central prediction of the task-based model of production: firms that automate more should see larger declines in routine employment and labor share. Using administrative data from France between 1994 and 2019, we find no support for this prediction. Changes in routine employment share are either uncorrelated or even negatively correlated with changes in labor share within firms. Our evidence shows that automation is not driving labor share dynamics in France.
abstract_zh: 关于劳动份额下降的一个主要解释是自动化。我们基于任务型生产模型的核心预测，在企业层面直接检验了这一机制：自动化程度更高的企业，其常规就业份额和劳动份额应出现更大幅度的下降。利用1994年至2019年法国的行政数据，我们发现这一预测未得到支持。在企业内部，常规就业份额的变化与劳动份额的变化要么不相关，甚至呈负相关。我们的证据表明，自动化并非法国劳动份额动态变化的驱动因素。

title: Two paths to prosperity: Culture and institutions in Europe and China, 1000–2000 Avner Greif, Joel Mokyr, and Guido Tabellini, (Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp. 533. ISBN 9780691265940. Hbk £35).

title_primary: 两条通往繁荣之路：欧洲与中国的文化与制度，1000–2000年
title_secondary: Two paths to prosperity: Culture and institutions in Europe and China, 1000–2000 Avner Greif, Joel Mokyr, and Guido Tabellini, (Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp. 533. ISBN 9780691265940. Hbk £35).
authors: Graham Brownlow
official: 官方在线 2026-06-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In Two Paths to Prosperity, Greif, Mokyr, and Tabellini (GMT) apply their formidable analytical powers to explaining the divergent trajectories followed by China and Western Europe. In the book's conclusion it is observed that, while much of the economic history literature is focused on the persistence of differences between societies, over the very long run historical reversals have also existed (p.468). Two Paths to Prosperity discusses such a reversal: the shift in the world's centre of economic gravity away from and then back towards China. GMT's description of their book as ‘a study of comparative economic history’ (p. 454) is simultaneously accurate and excessively modest. As I will set out in this short review, the book excels as such a study and so much more. I can only touch on a fraction of the many novel arguments they develop, however.
abstract_zh: 在《通往繁荣的两条路径》中，Greif、Mokyr与Tabellini（简称GMT）运用其卓越的分析能力，阐释了中国与西欧所遵循的迥异发展轨迹。该书结论部分指出，尽管经济史文献多聚焦于社会间差异的持续性，但在极长的时间跨度内，历史逆转现象亦曾存在（第468页）。《通往繁荣的两条路径》探讨了这样一种逆转：世界经济重心先远离中国，后又回归中国的转变。GMT将其著作描述为“一项比较经济史研究”（第454页），这一表述既准确又过于谦逊。正如本短评所述，该书作为此类研究堪称典范，其内涵远不止于此。然而，我只能触及他们提出的众多新颖论点中的一小部分。

title: Economic Yang–Mills Mass Gap in Global and Corridor Flow Networks: A Finite-Network Gauge-Econometric Framework for Measuring Systemic Shock Thresholds
title_zh: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量
title_primary: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量
title_secondary: Economic Yang–Mills Mass Gap in Global and Corridor Flow Networks: A Finite-Network Gauge-Econometric Framework for Measuring Systemic Shock Thresholds
authors: Gondauri, Davit
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study develops a finite-network gauge-econometric framework for measuring systemic shock thresholds in global and corridor flow networks. The central problem addressed is that conventional macroeconomic indicators describe output, growth, income depth, inflation, or trade exposure, but do not by themselves identify how systemic stress circulates through corridor-sensitive network structures or when a local disturbance becomes systemically transmissible. To address this gap, the study constructs a two-layer empirical architecture. Layer A is a completed ten-node benchmark of global and corridor-sensitive regional nodes connected by twenty-seven weighted undirected edges. Public macroeconomic anchors are transformed into a normalized systemic-stress field and then into a corridor-weighted graph, a stress-weighted adjacency matrix, an anti-symmetric economic gauge potential, triangular curvature, Yang-Mills economic action, a stress Laplacian, an Economic Mass Gap Index, fragility, BridgeStress, resilience, and scenario-based shock diagnostics. Layer B specifies a 100-country by 15-year validation architecture, producing a planned N = 1,500 country-year panel for fixed-effects, two-way fixed-effects, Driscoll-Kraay, clustered, dynamic-panel, panel-IV, factor, and external-validation models once the country-year variables are populated and estimated. The corrected benchmark yields a positive finite-network economic mass gap of lambda_1 = 0.3850, with spectral radius 3.5023 and normalized transition threshold 0.1099. Positive spectral separation is retained under high-weight, medium-filtered, and sparse-filtered graph specifications, while Monte Carlo perturbations keep the mass gap positive across the reported uncertainty interval. The curvature-action layer reports total Yang-Mills economic action of 2,514.0 and a top-five action concentration of 78.329%, indicating that systemic stress-energy is concentrated in a limited set of network cycles. Scenario simulations show that inflation, financial-spread, trade/logistics, and energy/geopolitical corridor shocks weaken spectral protection, compress the local-to-systemic threshold, and increase curvature/action concentration. EMGI, fragility, and BridgeStress further distinguish large output-mass nodes from strategically exposed corridor nodes such as the Caucasus and Central Asia. The finite-network dataset and replication package are archived on Zenodo as Version v1, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20786199 (Gondauri, 2026). The study contributes a reproducible macro-corridor measurement pipeline that integrates systemic-risk theory, network topology, spectral graph diagnostics, gauge-theoretic analogy, and econometric claim discipline. The term mass gap is used strictly in the finite weighted-graph sense and does not claim a solution to the mathematical Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem. Stronger causal and country-level econometric claims are reserved for the populated and estimated N = 1,500 panel.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将一项独特的企业调查与德国行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于企业如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的企业，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的企业，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的企业更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

title: Endogenous mobility in pandemics: Theory and evidence from the United States
title_zh: 大流行中的内生流动性：来自美国的理论与证据

authors: Xiao Chen, Hanwei Huang, Jiandong Ju, Ruoyan Sun, Jialiang Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze infectious diseases in a general equilibrium model with endogenous mobility, where forward-looking agents weigh disease risks against economic opportunities in cross-regional mobility decisions. This generates “self-containment” and “self-healing” mobility responses to regional differences in healthcare and prevalence. Applied to US COVID-19 data, our model reveals that cross-state mobility restrictions curbed infections by reducing cross-regional contacts but increased deaths and output losses by hindering mobility toward regions with better recovery outcomes. Relative to a model with exogenous mobility, our framework predicts fewer infections, lower mortality, and higher economic output following the unanticipated pandemic shock.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有内生流动性的一般均衡模型中分析传染病，其中前瞻性主体在跨区域流动决策中权衡疾病风险与经济机会。这产生了对区域医疗保健和患病率差异的“自我隔离”和“自我修复”流动性响应。应用于美国COVID-19数据，我们的模型揭示，跨州流动性限制通过减少跨区域接触遏制了感染，但通过阻碍向恢复结果更好区域的流动增加了死亡和产出损失。相对于具有外生流动性的模型，我们的框架在未预期疫情冲击后预测出更少的感染、更低的死亡率和更高的经济产出。

title: AI and Coder Employment: Compiling the Evidence
title_zh: 人工智能与程序员就业：证据汇编
title_primary: 人工智能与程序员就业：证据汇编
title_secondary: AI and Coder Employment: Compiling the Evidence
authors: Leland D. Crane, Paul E. Soto
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We evaluate whether LLMs have had any discernible impact on the aggregate labor market so far. We focus on occupations that are computer programming-intensive, motivated by data showing that coding is one of the most LLM-exposed tasks. Linking O*NET to CPS we find that aggregate employment of coders has decelerated sharply since the introduction of ChatGPT. Using a novel control variable for industry-level shocks we show that the deceleration is not attributable to the exposure of coders to slowing industries, suggesting instead that coders experienced an occupation-specific shock around the introduction of ChatGPT. Coder employment has continued to grow in recent years, though much more slowly than it did pre-2022. We validate the industry-level control variable by examining historical examples of occupations that experienced either occupation-specific or industry-level shocks. We also provide statistics on the agreement rates between different measures of AI exposure.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否对当前总体劳动力市场产生了可识别的影响。基于编码是最受LLM影响的任务之一的数据驱动，我们重点关注计算机编程密集型职业。通过将O*NET与当前人口调查（CPS）数据关联，我们发现自ChatGPT推出以来，编程人员的总体就业增速显著放缓。利用行业层面冲击的新型控制变量，我们证明这种放缓并非源于编程人员所在行业的衰退冲击，而是表明编程人员在ChatGPT推出前后经历了职业特异性冲击。近年来编程人员就业虽持续增长，但增速远低于2022年前的水平。我们通过考察历史上经历职业特异性冲击或行业层面冲击的职业案例，验证了行业层面控制变量的有效性，并提供了不同人工智能暴露度测量指标间的一致率统计。

title_secondary: The Extent of the Market for Early American Banknotes

abstract: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.
abstract_zh: 基于宾夕法尼亚州银行间关系与票据持有数据，本文估算了银行赎回其他银行票据的概率与地理距离的关联。若两家银行相距50英里，特定时点一家银行持有另一家银行票据的概率为40%；当距离增至200英里时，该概率几乎为零。通过对康涅狄格州小镇票据经纪人折价票据的分析发现，远距离票据主要由沿当时主要水路流动的旅行者与商人提供。

title: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure
title_zh: 低语中的进步：自动化恐惧与自愿性披露
title_primary: 低语中的进步：自动化恐惧与自愿性披露
title_secondary: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure
authors: Jun Oh, Guoman She
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how employee fears of automation-driven job displacement influence corporate disclosure of automation plans. Using a novel measure of local automation fear constructed from cable news transcripts, we document a robust negative relation between automation fear and firms’ propensity to provide forward-looking disclosure about automation strategies. This effect strengthens when disclosure conveys incremental information, when automation substitutes for labor, and when firms face greater union exposure or political costs. To strengthen identification, we exploit quasi-natural experiments that induce increases in automation fear, expected union resistance, and political costs, respectively. We also find suggestive evidence that firms increase private communication with investors to compensate for the reduction in public information provision. Overall, our findings shed light on the trade-offs between maintaining transparency and mitigating adverse employee and politician responses in the era of rapid technological advancement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了员工对自动化导致的工作岗位流失的恐惧如何影响企业披露自动化计划的行为。利用从有线新闻转录中构建的新型地方自动化恐惧指标，我们记录了自动化恐惧与企业提供前瞻性自动化战略披露倾向之间的稳健负相关关系。当披露传递增量信息、自动化替代劳动力以及企业面临更高的工会风险或政治成本时，这一效应会增强。为强化因果识别，我们分别利用引发自动化恐惧上升、预期工会抵制增强及政治成本增加的准自然实验。我们还发现初步证据表明，企业会增加与投资者的私下沟通，以弥补公开信息供给的减少。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了在技术快速进步时代，维持透明度与缓解员工及政治人物不利反应之间的权衡关系。

title: The limits of local laws in global supply chains: Cutting ties or “edutrading” procurement partners?
title_zh: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育型交易”采购伙伴？
title_primary: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育型交易”采购伙伴？
title_secondary: The limits of local laws in global supply chains: Cutting ties or “edutrading” procurement partners?
authors: Hendrik Keilbach, Michael Koetter, Melina Ludolph, Fabian Woebbeking
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the procurement patterns of non-listed firms and examine how these often-overlooked, yet pivotal players in global supply chains adjust their sourcing when they anticipate accountability for externalities beyond their organizational boundaries. Using granular customs data and a surprise information release about the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act, product-level regressions reveal that importing firms are 3.5 percentage points less likely to source a product from countries where the relevant production sector exhibits elevated ESG-related risks, suggesting that firms tend to cut ties with higher-risk suppliers. The effects are concentrated among firms with well-diversified supplier networks for a product and higher profitability, suggesting they have the necessary flexibility to respond quickly to anticipated regulatory pressure. Our findings suggest that mandates requiring firms to incorporate broad sustainability considerations into their operational decisions may have limits, particularly for non-listed firms.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了非上市企业的采购模式，并考察了这些在全球供应链中常被忽视却至关重要的参与者，在预期需为其组织边界之外的外部性承担责任时，如何调整其采购来源。利用细粒度海关数据及关于德国《供应链尽职调查法》的意外信息披露，产品层面的回归分析显示，进口企业从相关生产部门存在较高ESG相关风险的国家采购某产品的可能性降低了3.5个百分点，这表明企业倾向于切断与高风险供应商的联系。这一效应集中在拥有产品供应商网络多元化程度较高且盈利能力较强的企业中，暗示这些企业具备必要的灵活性，能够迅速响应预期的监管压力。我们的研究结果表明，要求企业将广泛的可持续性考量纳入运营决策的强制性规定可能存在局限性，尤其对非上市企业而言。

title: Full Discretion is Inevitable
title_zh: 完全自由裁量权不可避免
title_primary: 完全自由裁量权不可避免
title_secondary: Full Discretion is Inevitable
authors: Wenhao Li
official: 官方在线 2026-03-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article studies a dynamic project-selection game between a Principal and an Agent with conflicting interests. Only the Agent knows what projects are feasible. In each period before a project is selected, the Principal imposes a restriction set. The Agent can select any feasible project within this set, thereby ending the game. The Agent can also stay silent, in which case the game will proceed to the next period. Importantly, the Principal cannot commit to her future restriction sets. I show that when the Agent is sufficiently patient, the Principal fully delegates to the Agent in the unique equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个委托人与代理人之间利益冲突的动态项目选择博弈。只有代理人知晓哪些项目是可行的。在每个项目被选定之前的每个时期，委托人施加一个限制集合。代理人可以在该集合内选择任何可行的项目，从而结束博弈。代理人也可以保持沉默，在这种情况下，博弈将进入下一时期。重要的是，委托人无法承诺其未来的限制集合。我证明，当代理人足够有耐心时，在唯一均衡中，委托人会将决策权完全委托给代理人。

title: Dual forces: educational development and digital innovation steering BRICS to carbon neutrality
title_zh: 双重动力：教育发展与数字创新引领金砖国家迈向碳中和
title_primary: 双重动力：教育发展与数字创新引领金砖国家迈向碳中和
title_secondary: Dual forces: educational development and digital innovation steering BRICS to carbon neutrality
authors: Kaixin Zheng Shuyun Chang Zhang Yue Shiyiu Liu a Antai College of Economics & Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong Universityb College of Humanities and Law, Harbin University, Harbin, Heilong Jiang, Chinac Humanity and Art College 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: BRICS nations – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – stand at a critical crossroads. These countries, while achieving impressive economic growth and urbanization over the past few decades, now face escalating environmental challenges. This study dives deep into the interplay between educational development, digital transformation, and environmental sustainability in BRICS nations from 1990 to 2022. The analysis employs dynamic panel data techniques, including Two-Step System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), AMG, CCEMG, Fixed Effects models, and also Granger causality to capture the relationships between educational components and environmental outcomes effectively. The GMM outcomes reveal a double-edged sword: economic growth (EG) drives environmental degradation, whereas digital transformation (DT) emerges as a powerful counterforce, significantly mitigating emissions. The first model highlights primary education’s (SEP) vital role in fostering sustainable practices, showing a significant positive effect on reducing carbon emissions (CE). The second model underscores the impact of secondary education (SES), with increased investment proving pivotal in advancing environmental sustainability. The third model brings tertiary education (SET) into the spotlight, emphasizing its crucial contribution to enhancing environmental outcomes. The robustness of these findings is reinforced through rigorous-fixed effects panel regression analysis, consistently affirming the interconnectedness of education, digital transformation, and urbanization in tackling environmental challenges.
abstract_zh: 金砖国家——巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非——正站在关键的十字路口。这些国家在过去几十年实现了令人瞩目的经济增长和城市化进程，但如今面临着日益严峻的环境挑战。本研究深入探讨了1990年至2022年间金砖国家教育发展、数字化转型与环境可持续性之间的相互作用。分析采用动态面板数据技术，包括两步系统广义矩估计法（GMM）、AMG、CCEMG、固定效应模型，以及格兰杰因果检验，以有效捕捉教育要素与环境结果之间的关系。GMM结果显示了一柄双刃剑：经济增长（EG）加剧了环境退化，而数字化转型（DT）则成为强大的反制力量，显著减少了排放。第一个模型凸显了初等教育（SEP）在促进可持续实践中的关键作用，表明其对减少碳排放（CE）具有显著的积极影响。第二个模型强调了中等教育（SES）的影响，增加投入被证明是推进环境可持续性的关键。第三个模型将高等教育（SET）置于聚光灯下，强调其在改善环境结果方面的重要贡献。通过严格的固定效应面板回归分析，这些发现得到了进一步强化，一致证实了教育、数字化转型和城市化在应对环境挑战中的相互关联性。
